We are a small-town tree company run by a family who truly cares about the people in our community! We work hard to maintain a solid reputation because knowing we’re helping our neighbors means the world to us. At Chris’s Tree Service, our goal is simple — when we finish a job, we want your property to look even better than when we arrived. With over 60 years of combined experience in tree care, you can trust that we’ve seen it all and handled it all.

From trimming and pruning to full tree removal, stump grinding, and land clearing, our skilled team takes pride in doing every job safely and efficiently. We also offer landscaping, pest control, and herbicide application to keep your yard healthy and beautiful year-round. Whether you need one tree removed or a complete property cleanup, we approach every project with the same level of dedication and respect.

We’re not just working in your yard — we’re serving our community, one property at a time. Give us a call today for a free estimate and see why so many homeowners in our area trust Chris’s Tree Service for all their outdoor needs!
